html:
The QOU column is the m_e-scaled realization of the dimensionless mass ratio (CAL-1 sets the MeV scale by fiat); absolute mass in MeV is not an independent framework prediction.

Particle QOU (MeV) Observed (MeV) Sig figs Status
\mu^- 105.658 105.658 6 \mathrm{Vol}(4_1)/\hbar_{q_0}^2 comparison
Proton 938.272^{\dagger} 938.272 6 CAL-2 numerical q_0 pin; \rho_K^{\mathrm{LO}} input
Neutron 939.565^{\dagger} 939.565 6 \rho_K^{\mathrm{LO}} empirical input (not ab initio)
n--p splitting 1.293^{\dagger} 1.293 4 \rho_K^{\mathrm{LO}} input difference (not ab initio)
\pi^{\pm} 139.570^{\ddagger} 139.570 6 CAL-3 calibration input
K^{\pm} 493.677 493.677 6 Derived m_K/m_\pi ratio
Deuteron 1875.613^{\dagger} 1875.613 7 \rho_K^{\mathrm{LO}} constituent + AME2020 input
D binding 2.224 2.225 3 Single-bond comparison
{}^3\mathrm{He} 2808.39^{\dagger} 2808.39 6 \rho_K^{\mathrm{LO}} constituent + AME2020 input
{}^4\mathrm{He} 3727.38^{\dagger} 3727.38 6 \rho_K^{\mathrm{LO}} constituent + AME2020 input

{}^{\dagger} Leading-order (\rho_K^{\mathrm{LO}}) assembly, not an ab initio prediction. In the leading-order density factor \rho_K^{\mathrm{LO}}, the |\mathrm{tr}_M| factor cancels in \rho_K^{\mathrm{LO}} \cdot m_e \cdot |\mathrm{tr}_M|, returning the injected CODATA nucleon masses Z m_{\mathfrak{p}} + N m_{\mathfrak{n}} and AME2020 nuclear binding inputs by construction (with m_{\mathfrak{p}}/m_e serving as the numerical anchor for CAL-2 q_0); the ab initio z = q^3/(q^2+1) \beta-decay evaluation currently gives \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{scored}} \approx 0.3254\;\text{MeV} (\mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{n}} - \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{p}} \approx 0.8364\;\text{MeV}). {}^{\ddagger} Calibration input (CAL-3). The charged-pion mass fixes the orthogonal meson-scale class, so only ratios such as m_K/m_\pi carry predictive content.
